entries.note: Shipment details created; the sender is still preparing the parcel. The sentence names the branch it will leave from, which is no scan place.
At the origin branch, being prepared for the transfer centre. The sentence names that branch.
Leaving the origin branch for a transfer centre, or the destination transfer centre for the delivering branch.
At the delivering branch, which the sentence names.
Rerouted to another delivering branch; the sentence names where it is sent, not where it is.
At the new delivering branch after a reroute.
Out with a courier, also after a failed attempt. The sentence gives the carrier's courier line.
The label with its reason after a colon, as the adapter writes it. Any reason after this label is a failed delivery.
Any reason after this label is a failed delivery. Its other reason seen is a sentence saying nobody was at the address and until when the parcel waits at a named branch.
"Devir" carries the parcel over to the next delivery day after an attempt that did not deliver it.
Left without a stage: a planned attempt with any reason other than "Devir" announces a delivery still to come.
The sentence names whoever received the parcel, which the adapter does not read.
Final for this number: the sentence says the parcel is on its way back to its sender, which the tracker follows under a return number of its own.
